{{Top|leg}}
A '''burrower drive''' was a means of locomotion for [[mining droid]]s. It allowed the droid to move at half-speed through the crust of a planet. It could also be used as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]], but it would cause damage to the drill gears and bits of the drive.
